pair.title: Xzense PIN
pair.select_help: Select your Xzense controller. Several controllers nearby? The stronger signal (closer to 0 dBm) is the one nearest to Homey.
pair.none_found: No Xzense controller found. Move Homey closer, make sure no other app is connected to it, and search again.
pair.pin_help: Enter the 4-character PIN of your Xzense controller (digits 0-9 and letters A-F).
pair.invalid_pin: The PIN must be 4 characters: 0-9 and A-F.
pair.bad_pin: The controller rejected the PIN. Check the PIN and try again.
pair.no_contact: Could not talk to the controller. Move Homey closer and make sure no other app is connected to it.
pair.not_in_list: Select a controller from the list first.
